macros.name: gbheader
macros.doc: In order to have both the first and the last numbered section in the headline of the page, use the command \gbheader.

macros.name: gbsection
macros.doc: The \gbsection{⟨id⟩} macro is the core of the package, defining the different (numbered) sections of the gamebook.

macros.name: gbturn
macros.doc: References to numbered sections are typeset using \gbturn, which puts the text defined in \gbturntext before the reference.

macros.name: gbvillain
macros.doc: Villains and other kinds of opponents are typeset within a special tabbing environment.

envs.name: gbturnoptions
envs.doc: If there are many options for the reader at the end of one section, you can use the environment gbturnoptions for printing an indented list of these options.

envs.name: gbturnoptions
envs.doc: If there are many options for the reader at the end of one section, you can use the environment gbturnoptions for printing an indented list of these options.
